## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if applicable.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and any relevant limitations. Include screenshots for visible UI changes.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented where needed.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass and behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] No real chats, account credentials, traffic dumps, certificates, or private data are included.
- [ ] Capture and local AI processing remain explicit and respect existing privacy controls.
